edges.sentence: On 2026-08-28, The Guardian reported “Two days earlier, Italian police said they had recovered three paintings by the French masters Paul Cézanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir and Henri Matisse that were taken this year from a private museum near the northern city of Parma.”; on 2026-08-27, Deutsche Welle reported “Shortly before that, Italian police said they had recovered three paintings by Renoir, Cezanne and Matisse stolen from a museum near Parma .”.

On 2026-09-08, UPI reported “Of the three paintings whose recovery was announced last month”; on 2026-08-27, Deutsche Welle reported “Shortly before that, Italian police said they had recovered three paintings by Renoir, Cezanne and Matisse stolen from a museum near Parma .”.

On 2026-09-08, UPI reported “Of the three paintings whose recovery was announced last month”; on 2026-08-28, The Guardian reported “Two days earlier, Italian police said they had recovered three paintings by the French masters Paul Cézanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir and Henri Matisse that were taken this year from a private museum near the northern city of Parma.”.
